procedures.name: Battery monitoring system (BMS) reset
procedures.description: Tells the body control module that the battery was replaced, so the charging strategy and battery state estimate start fresh. Run it after fitting a new battery.
warnings: Only run this after a battery replacement. If the vehicle reports 'service procedure interrupted', leave it with the doors closed for about 30 minutes so all modules sleep, then retry.
manual: Alternative without a scan tool (reported on owner forums, not verified here): ignition on, engine off.
Pull and release the high beam lever 5 times, then press and release the brake pedal 3 times, all within about 10 seconds.
If it worked, the battery warning lamp flashes 3 times within the next 15 seconds.
procedures.source: Routine 201A on the BCM (0x726) in an extended session is described in community guides for Ford diagnostic tools; FORScan offers the same function. Not verified on hardware by this project.

procedures.name: Restart module (hard reset)
procedures.description: Power-cycles the selected module (UDS ECUReset, hard reset). Useful to apply a configuration change or recover a module that stopped answering.
warnings: Safety systems (airbag, ABS, steering) are unavailable while they restart. Do not run this while driving.

procedures.name: Restart module (key off/on reset)
procedures.description: Simulates a key cycle for the selected module (UDS ECUReset, key off/on).
warnings: The module restarts and may log communication faults in other modules; clear them afterwards.

procedures.name: Which on-board tests does the engine module support? (Mode 08)
procedures.description: Asks the powertrain module which SAE J1979 mode 08 test IDs it supports (for example the EVAP leak test). It only reads the support bitmap; no test is started.
procedures.source: SAE J1979 mode 08 (request on-board system, test or component control).
